cells.A: Space Sector Knowledge Base — ontology, product classifier and tags

cells.B: Three independent axes + ontology: ESA Generic Product Tree = product hierarchy; NASA TX / ESA Technology Tree = technology tags; EUSPA = application/market tags.
ESA Generic Product Tree (GPT), Issue 1 Rev 1. Official Level 1 segments: I Launchers; II Satellites & Probes; III Orbital Transportation & Re-entry Systems; IV Ground Segment.
Use NASA 2024 Technology Taxonomy and ESA Technology Tree v4.1 as many-to-many tags. Do not use them as product/market categories.
cells.E: If it is a product, assign ESA GPT path
cells.F: one primary path; secondary mappings allowed

cells.B: Use the 16 EUSPA EU Space Market Report 2026 segments as many-to-many downstream application/market tags.

Organization, Program, Mission, Product, Spacecraft, Constellation, Launch Event, Component, Payload, Facility, Terminal, Service, Dataset, Contract, Partnership, Licence/Filing, Patent, R&D Project, Technology.
Organization ≠ Program ≠ Product/Asset ≠ Service ≠ Contract/Filing. Store typed relations between them.

Where the 2011 ESA GPT does not explicitly represent modern categories such as user terminals, GSaaS or cloud/data services, keep the official GPT segment mapping and mark the detailed node as KB_EXTENSION.
cells.F: source URL / record ID / retrieved date / confidence
